name: Ethereum Challenge Signer
description: Signs an arbitrary challenge string with an Ethereum private key (EIP-191 personal_sign).

privateKey.description: Ethereum private key hex string (0x...). Prefer using a dedicated hot key with minimal funds/permissions.

parameters.name: privateKey
parameters.description: Ethereum private key hex string (0x...). Prefer using a dedicated hot key with minimal funds/permissions.

parameters.name: seed
parameters.description: Optiona lseed for deterministic key generation (e.g. from a mnemonic). If provided, the same private key will be generated for the same seed.
